$comment: The docs site's install manifest, phase 14. It is this site's own file and not a generated copy of the portal's: the two share a mark and share nothing else, because an installed documentation site opening on the job board would be the wrong application. It sits in public/ because that is the directory the build empties into the root of dist/, which is also what gets it precached: writeWorker() in scripts/build.js takes everything under public/ verbatim. Written in English only, and deliberately, for the reason the portal's carries: a manifest is fetched with no session and no localStorage, so it has no way of knowing which language the reader chose, and 16f keeps the choice a stored preference rather than an address. The icons are the portal's four, copied in by gen-docs-lib.js rather than linked across, per part 2b: two Vercel projects are two origins, and an installed icon fetched from the other one is a blank icon the day that project moves. theme_color is white to agree with what theme.js writes into meta[name=theme-color] for the default classic light theme, so the title bar does not change colour a moment after launch. background_color is the GFTV yellow the icon plate sits on, so the splash screen and the icon are one colour.
name: Careers@GFTV documentation
description: Guides to the Careers@GFTV job portal and its Telegram bot. How to find a role and apply, how to link Telegram, and how to help with translations.
$comment-shortcuts: Public sections only. A shortcut into /staff would open the sign in page for the reader who is not staff, which is a menu item that fails for almost everybody who has one, and the gate in 16a is deliberately quiet about what it holds.
